description:
Submission & escalation co-pilot for a bug-bounty finding. Paste your DRAFT finding (and what you
already tried / couldn't achieve) and get a grounded brief built from the closest REAL disclosed reports:
(1) precedent & validity — is this an accepted class, with citable reports (ammunition if it was
disputed/closed); (2) what's novel/stronger about yours — what to lead with; (3) an escalation playbook
INCLUDING moves you may NOT have tried, each with honest feasibility; (4) submission-framing tips.

Every cited report URL is validated against the retrieved corpus — ungrounded citations are flagged in
'citations.ungrounded' with 'citations_grounded=false', so the brief can't smuggle in a fabricated precedent
(this guards the citations only — never read it as a verdict on whether your finding itself is real).
Optional 'query' overrides the retrieval text (default: the finding itself); limit (default 15) caps the prior-art reports. Complements
find_attack_approaches (which returns the raw prior-art cards).
name: assist_submission
title: Strengthen a bug-bounty submission
